summary: Document-only revision adding psana/psana/gpu/docs/proposals/synthetic_mfx_expand10.md and a supersession notice in synthetic_jungfrau_decompression_cube.md. All stated sizes, ratios, rates and durations recompute exactly from 32 panels x 524,288 uint16 pixels with ceil(N/10)=52,429 stored words per panel (last group 8 pixels). Stream-to-physical-panel mapping matches notes/mfx_real_codec_20261105/gate-result.json; source event count (36,037), ten source streams (JF at indices 5-9, five ancillary), 32 segment IDs and (3, 32, 512, 1024) float32 constant layouts match notes/synthetic_mfx_stage1_20261103/manifest.json. The plan correctly distinguishes image shape (32,512,1024) from the gain-axis constant layout, describes the stored array as a rank-1 UINT16 seed (a type/rank dgram.cc supports), and explicitly states that the adapter, persistent cube state and any codec are not implemented. Runs 1-2 and XPP runs 3-4 are preserved; new runs 5/6 are proposed only after collision checks. Relative links to the notes directories, the calibration example and the persistent-task proposal resolve in this checkout. The superseded XPP document keeps its completed Stage 2 record intact. One low, non-blocking wording inconsistency noted.
checks: Panel order per stream (s005-s009) identical to gate-result.json panel_order and to mfx_real_codec README table
Source run 10 event_count 36037 in all ten manifest streams; JF stream_indices [5,6,7,8,9]; 32 segment IDs 0-31 with unique detector IDs; five ancillary streams (0-4) present
Calibration constants in manifest: pedestals/pixel_gain/pixel_offset/status/rms/min/max float32 (3,32,512,1024), geometry str; plan's shape vs gain-axis statements consistent
jungfrau_calibration.py _layout requires C-contiguous uint16 (events, segments, rows, columns) and (3, physical segments, rows, columns) constants, matching plan lines 87-90
dgram.cc handles Name::UINT16 with rank>=1 arrays (lines 569-582); rank-1 UINT16 seed field is representable
Expansion semantics: repeat(seed,10)[:524288] equals raw[i]=seed[i//10]; sampling raw[::10] never crosses a panel; gain bits retained per word
Relative links ../../../../../notes/... and ../../examples/jungfrau_calibration.py and persistent_task_state_xpp_cube.md resolve from proposals/ directory

Lifecycle: runs 1-2 unchanged, runs 3-4 reserved for XPP (consistent with superseded doc line 7), runs 5/6 only proposed, no DB changes; staged validation (tiny fixture -> 1000-event pilot -> 400k) present
No implication that adapter, persistent state or codec exists (lines 69, 89-91, 153); real-codec and raw-size results preserved and linked as evidence
Supersession notice present at top of synthetic_jungfrau_decompression_cube.md; completed Stage 2 record retained unchanged below it
No runtime tests expected or claimed for this document-only change
limitations: Read-only review via file tools; no commands executed and no tests run. Validation evidence is limited to CPU arithmetic and source/document cross-checks.
manifest.json (5,761 lines) was read in part (lines 1-1536) plus targeted greps for stream counts, event counts, constant shapes and segment IDs; not every stream record was inspected line by line.

Actual XTC files under /sdf/data/lcls/ds/prj/public01/xtc and scratch artifacts were not accessible to this review; Configure membership and L1Accept child order are taken from the manifest/gate-result records, which the plan itself says must be re-verified before generation.
Existence or absence of prjdatpsana runs 5/6 in the run database could not be checked; the plan defers this to a preflight.
